pairs.question: Quis detrahet me in terram?
pairs.derivation: Edom's prideful boast quoted in v3 (framed by speech-tag 'qui dicit in corde suo', dropped) is a real interrogative: 'who will bring me down to earth?'. The Lord answers in v4; the opening 'si exaltatus fueris ut aquila et si inter sidera posueris nidum tuum' is a non-answering conditional preamble, so the answer starts at the operative 'inde detraham te', dropping the trailing speech-tag 'dicit Dominus'. Section/verse numbers and the title/footer scaffolding were excluded.
